rationale: No suitable optimization is supported. The strongest candidate, P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads), is contraindicated because the workflow already caches Gradle dependencies via actions/setup-java@v5 with cache: 'gradle', matching the pattern's 'An equivalent cache already exists' contraindication. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply because the workflow has no matrix jobs. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks the precondition of representative successful-duration history (CI history is a single run labeled not_a_measured_baseline). P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is only simulation_estimate and the workflow signs APKs and uploads signed release artifacts, which falls under the release/deployment-work contraindication. Applying a redundant cache or speculative cancellation would risk unrelated changes without preserving coverage cleanly.
